notes.row: One result row is one check-in × nights × board × rooms combination for this file's party and promo.
notes.per_night: price_per_night is total_price / nights for the whole booking, including both rooms when rooms is 2.
notes.half_board: Half board is a separate MealPlan rate (חצי פנסיון, code HB) on roomData, with its own total Price. It is not a per-person add-on. SpecialServices was null on every captured rate. Room only is RO (לינה בלבד) and bed and breakfast is BB (כולל ארוחת בוקר).
notes.two_rooms: rooms=2 is priced by summing one rate per room. The split keeps at least one adult in each room. For 2 adults and 3 children the candidates are (1 adult + 2 children) + (1 adult + 1 child) and (1 adult + 3 children) + (1 adult). The cheaper valid split is stored on the row. The same room code is used twice only when AvailableRooms says at least two remain.
notes.promo: promo=none is the public rate. Its booking_url has no promocode parameter. promo=mhot is a separate scrape of the same stays with promocode=mhot on the fetched URL and on booking_url. The code is not a flat percent off: some package rates change, list-price rates can stay put, and a room type can disappear, so the with-code total can be higher than the public total. Do not derive mhot by multiplying.
notes.booking_url: booking_url and url are the BE_Rooms.aspx search that produced the row. promo=none has no promocode parameter. promo=mhot includes promocode=mhot.
